product.name: Monoprice 60W USB‑C 5‑Port Desktop Charging Station
product.description: Monoprice™60W USB‑C® 5‑Port Desktop Charging Station60 watts of USB Type‑C® Power Delivery (PD) and 18W of Qualcomm® Quick Charge™ (QC) fast chargingCharge all your USB‑powered devices using the 60W USB‑C® 5‑Port Desktop Charging Station from Monoprice™. This 5‑port charging station includes both USB Type‑C® and Type‑A ports for compatibility with the overwhelming majority of USB powered devices. The Type‑C port can deliver up to 60W of USB Type‑C Power Delivery (PD), allowing it to charge laptops, even while they are in use. It can also charge a USB‑C tablet or phone from 0% to more than 50% charge level in less than 30 minutes.Fast charging is not limited to the USB‑C port. One of the four Type‑A ports features Qualcomm® Quick Charge™ (QC) 3.0 fast charging, with up to 18W of power to charge compatible devices up to 3 times faster than standard battery charging. The remaining Type‑A ports each provide up to 5 VDC, 2.4A (12W) charging power. The internal circuitry in the charging station intelligently allocates power to charge each connected device with the optimal level of power for best overall performance. The compact and lightweight design is easy to pack in a laptop bag, backpack, tote, or purse for easy and fast charging on the go.Up to 60W of USB Type‑C® Power Delivery (PD) to charge laptops, tablets, and phones of all typesThe Qualcomm® Quick Charge (QC) 3.0 port provides up to 18W of power to charge compatible devices up to 3x faster than standard battery chargingThree USB Type‑A ports provide up to 5 VDC, 2.4A (12W) of charging powerIntelligent power allocations provides the optimal power level for each connected device3.3‑foot detachable power cord allows for desktop placement and usePower cord can be easily replaced with a longer version HIGH POWER AND FAST CHARGINGThe USB Type‑C® port delivers up to 60W of USB Type‑C Power Delivery (PD), allowing it to charge laptops, even while they are in use. It can also charge a USB‑C® tablet or phone from 0% to more than 50% charge level in less than 30 minutes. One of the four Type‑A ports features Qualcomm® Quick Charge™ (QC) 3.0 fast charging, with up to 18W of power to charge compatible devices up to 3 times faster than standard battery charging. The remaining Type‑A ports each provide up to 5 VDC, 2.4A (12W) charging power, significantly more than standard 5W chargers. CHARGE 5 DEVICES AT THE SAME TIMEWith five charging ports, you won't have to decide which device to charge first. Plug them all in and let the intelligent power allocation provide the optimal power level to each device for best overall performance. UNIVERSAL COMPATIBILITYFeaturing both USB Type‑A and Type‑C® charging ports, this charging station is universally compatible with any USB‑powered device, including laptops, tablets, phones, and more, regardless of manufacturer or brand. DESKTOP DESIGNWhile most chargers plug directly into a wall outlet, this charging stations includes a 3.3‑foot long, detachable AC power cord, allowing it to be placed on your desk, where it can be more easily accessed. The power cord is a standard NEMA® 1‑15 to IEC 60320 C7 type, so it can be easily replaced with a longer power cord, if 3.3 feet isn't long enough to reach an outlet. COMPACT AND LIGHTWEIGHTMeasuring just 3.2" x 3.2" x 1.2" and weighing only 6.9 ounces, you can easily pack and carry this powerful, all‑in‑one charging station in your laptop bag, backpack, tote, or purse for easy and fast charging on the go.Pick The Perfect Charger or Charging Station That Fits Your Needs     P/N43791 41986 41988 USB Charging Ports1x Type‑C®, 4x USB Type‑A2x Type‑C, 2x USB Type‑A2x Type‑CiPhone® Fast ChargingYesYesYesSamsung® Fast ChargingYesYesYesMacBook® CompatibleYesYesYesTotal USB Type‑C® Power Delivery (PD)60W100W68WIndividual Ports WattageC1: 60WA1: 12WA2: 12WA3: 12WA4: 18WC1: 100WC2: 18WA1: 12WA2: 12WC1: 18WC2: 60WTravel FriendlyYesYesYesBest ForiPhones and other smartphones, compatible tablets, etc.Simultaneous device charging, compatible laptops, tablets, iPhones and other smartphones, etc.Simultaneous device charging, iPhones and other smartphones, tablets, compatible laptops, etc.Dimensions3.2" x 3.2" x 1.2" (81 x 81 x 30 mm)3.2" x 1.2" x 3.1" (81 x 30 x 79 mm)2.6" x 1.2" x 2.5" (66 x 30 x 64 mm)Weight6.9 oz.
